attributes.description: This is the ultimate first version of meteorologic data to be swalled by Parflow/CLM.
attributes.__structure__:
ATTRS:
  description: This is the ultimate first version of meteorologic data to be swalled
    by Parflow/CLM.
  VERSION: 0.0.0
COORDS:
  date_time:
    name: date_time
    coords:
    - date_time
    unit: null
    type: null
    df_col: date_time
    source_unit: null
    range: null
    composed:
    - date_time
    chunk_size: 1024
    step_limits: any_new
    sorted: true
  site_id:
    name: site_id
    coords:
    - site_id
    unit: null
    type: int32
    na_value: 0
    description: Estimated location ID according to the table of possible locations.
      Including the lab.
    df_col: site_id
    source_unit: null
    range: null
    composed:
    - site_id
    chunk_size: 512
    step_limits: any_new
    sorted: []
VARS:
  APCP:
    name: APCP
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: millimeter / second
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Total precipitation rate for ParFlow/CLM
    df_col: APCP
    source_unit: millimeter / second
    range: null
  Temp:
    name: Temp
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: kelvin
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Air temperature for ParFlow/CLM
    df_col: Temp
    source_unit: kelvin
    range: null
  UGRD:
    name: UGRD
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: meter / second
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Eastward wind component for ParFlow/CLM
    df_col: UGRD
    source_unit: meter / second
    range: null
  VGRD:
    name: VGRD
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: meter / second
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Northward wind component for ParFlow/CLM
    df_col: VGRD
    source_unit: meter / second
    range: null
  Press:
    name: Press
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: pascal
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Atmospheric pressure for ParFlow/CLM
    df_col: Press
    source_unit: pascal
    range: null
  SPFH:
    name: SPFH
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: dimensionless
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Specific humidity for ParFlow/CLM
    df_col: SPFH
    source_unit: dimensionless
    range: null
  DSWR:
    name: DSWR
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: watt / meter ** 2
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Downward shortwave radiation for ParFlow/CLM
    df_col: DSWR
    source_unit: watt / meter ** 2
    range: null
  DLWR:
    name: DLWR
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: watt / meter ** 2
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Downward longwave radiation for ParFlow/CLM
    df_col: DLWR
    source_unit: watt / meter ** 2
    range: null
  longitude:
    name: longitude
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: degree
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: GPS. Signed Earth longitude. Indicated by the probe itself.
    df_col: longitude
    source_unit: degree
    range: null
  latitude:
    name: latitude
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: degree
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: GPS. Signed Earth latitude. Indicated by the probe itself.
    df_col: latitude
    source_unit: degree
    range: null
  elevation:
    name: elevation
    coords:
    - date_time
    - site_id
    unit: meter
    type: float64
    na_value: .nan
    description: Elevation above the sea level.
    df_col: elevation
    source_unit: meter
    range: null
